description: This file defines a singleton object RetrofitClient used for configuring and providing access to a Retrofit API service. It manages the base URL dynamically and ensures the Retrofit instance is rebuilt when the URL changes.

methods.name: getApiService
methods.description: Returns an instance of ApiService, initializing or rebuilding Retrofit if necessary.

methods.name: setBaseUrl
methods.description: Updates the base URL used for API calls and resets the Retrofit instance.
